title: How Do AI Agents Waste Your Money?
abstract: arXiv:2611.07238v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents may consume massive tokens across a wide range of tasks, but how many of those tokens are really necessary? Although prior work has shown that agents can incur unexpectedly high token costs, we still lack a systematic way to identify and measure token waste. In this work, we introduce a unified framework for measuring token waste across heterogeneous agent systems. Our framework records and normalizes complete agent trajectories, identifies removable spans using an LLM-as-a-Judge (LLMaJ), and maps the identified text spans back to the original trajectory for token-level measurement. We validate the identified waste through direct interventions by removing marked spans, resuming agent execution, and measuring changes in task outcomes and subsequent actions. In online pruning experiments, we remove 41-46% of the model's reasoning while largely preserving task performance across two distinct agent benchmarks. Using this framework,

translated_title: AI智能体是如何浪费你的金钱的？
translated_abstract: AI智能体在各种任务中可能消耗大量token，但这些token中究竟有多少是真正必要的？尽管先前的研究已经表明智能体会产生出乎意料的高昂token成本，我们目前仍缺乏一种系统性的方法来识别和度量token浪费。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个统一的框架，用于度量异构智能体系统中的token浪费。该框架记录并规范化完整的智能体轨迹，使用LLM-as-a-Judge（LLMaJ）识别可移除的文本片段，并将识别出的文本片段映射回原始轨迹以进行token级别的度量。我们通过直接干预来验证所识别的浪费：移除被标记的片段、恢复智能体的执行，并测量任务结果和后续动作的变化。在在线剪枝实验中，我们在两个不同的智能体基准测试上移除了41-46%的模型推理，同时基本保持了任务性能。
tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的token浪费度量框架，利用LLM-as-a-Judge识别智能体轨迹中可移除的内容，并通过在线剪枝实验证明可以在保持任务性能的同时减少41-46%的模型推理token。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a unified framework for measuring token waste across heterogeneous AI agent systems, which uses LLM-as-a-Judge to identify removable spans and demonstrates that online pruning can remove 41-46% of model reasoning while largely preserving task performance.
